limitations: The encoder was previously trained on all Train sources. The source-held partition is a validation set for this head fit, not an independently held model effectiveness cohort.
Only one head-fit seed and the preexisting small original Dev were measured. No general economic advantage is established.
Controlled financial documents and manager replies are generated and do not establish real organizational effectiveness.
The replay connection is covered by regression tests but full encoder retraining after it is not included in this report.
Head weights and raw representations are published; full parent ModernBERT weights are still required for end-to-end model inference.
